subject: Datascape POC — prompt sampling, acceptance criteria, and ownership
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@datascape.ai>
Cc: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@datascape.ai>
Date: 2028-04-11T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Datascape POC — prompt sampling, acceptance criteria, and ownership

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate the clarity on the three primary QA scenarios you care about (invoice extraction, policy question answering, and multi-turn troubleshooting). Recap and proposed next steps below so we have alignment before the kickoff: 

Summary of what we heard
- Top evaluation goals: precision on key fields (invoice# / total), factual correctness on policy Q&A, and helpfulness for multi-turn troubleshooting flows.
- You have a ~30k prompt/log corpus (anonymized) and can deliver a 2k sample subset to start.

Requested next steps (action items)
1) Datascape: Share a zipped sample of ~2,000 prompts/logs in CSV or newline-delimited JSON. Please exclude any PII; a redaction checklist is below. Attach filename reference once uploaded. (owner: Datascape)
2) Redwood: We will produce an evaluation plan (metric definitions, baseline model, pass/fail thresholds) and a prompt sampling checklist. (owner: Karthik / Priyom)
3) Kickoff: Schedule POC kickoff next week to lock timelines and owners. Proposed window: Apr 16–18.

Minimum success criteria (draft)
- Invoice extraction: >= 92% F1 for invoice_number and total_amount on sampled test set.
- Policy Q&A: >= 84% factual accuracy (as judged by Datascape SMEs).
- Troubleshooting assist: >= 30% reduction in average task completion time in simulated flows.

Please confirm you can share the 2k sample by end of day Friday (Apr 13), and whether CSV or JSON is easier for your export pipeline. Once you confirm, I will share the template for the sample file and the redaction checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment stubs: POC_kickoff_agenda_datascape.pdf (agenda), prompt_sample_template.csv (template)
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@datascape.ai>

Date: 2028-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Datascape POC — prompt sampling, acceptance criteria, and ownership

Thanks Karthik — this is a perfect summary. Quick answers: 

- We can deliver the 2k sample by end of day Friday (Apr 13). Our preferred export format is newline-delimited JSON (one event per line). We will also include an index.csv with original log ids.
- Files will be uploaded to the S3 bucket we shared earlier; I will reply with the full path once upload completes.

Preliminary success criteria from my side (SME input):
- Invoices: we care about both exact match for invoice IDs and tolerant matching for amounts (small OCR variance ok). If you can include a numeric tolerance parameter in the eval, that would help.
- Policy Q&A: we will annotate a 200-item adjudication set (internal SMEs) to use as golden labels.
- Troubleshooting: we will provide 50 representative multi-turn sessions and judge end-state success.

Two asks for Redwood:
1) Please share the sample file schema (fields we should include) and a short redaction checklist (we will remove PII but want to ensure we do it correctly).
2) Can Redwood run the baseline model with quantization turned on for cost estimates? If so, provide an estimate of token cost for the 2k set.

I'll upload the sample and post the S3 path by EOD Apr 13.

—Elena
Head of Data Science | Datascape
elena.ruiz@datascape.ai

Other items to include in your plan: metric definitions, sample size splits, tooling (Jupyter, eval harness link), owner for SME labeling, and a proposed kickoff slot (I suggested Apr 16–18 to Datascape).

Subject: RE: Datascape POC — prompt sampling, acceptance criteria, and ownership

Karthik / Marissa / Elena / Ravi —

Thanks — below is a concise POC evaluation plan and owners. I've prioritized a fast, measurable loop so Datascape can see value quickly.

POC eval plan (10 business days from sample receipt)
- Day 0 (sample received): verify schema & redaction, run light QA pass. Owner: Marissa. Deliverable: ingestion_report.md and example parsed rows.
- Day 1–2: construct dev/test splits (80/10/10 by session id), generate golden-label buckets for invoice extraction and policy Q&A. Owner: Marissa + Datascape SMEs. Deliverable: labeled_adjudication_batch_200.csv (policy Q&A)
- Day 3–5: baseline model runs (we will evaluate two configurations):
  * baseline-1: open-llm-1 (float32) — metric baseline
  * baseline-2: open-llm-1-quant (8-bit) — cost-aware baseline
  Owner: Priyom. Deliverable: baseline_results.json, token_cost_estimate.txt
- Day 6–8: targeted tuning and rerun on dev set (if needed). Owner: Priyom.
- Day 9–10: final evaluation on test set, compile pass/fail report and recommended next steps. Owner: Karthik. Deliverable: poc_final_report.pdf

Metric definitions (explicit)
- Invoice extraction: field-level F1 (invoice_id, total_amount). numeric-tolerance for total_amount = 1.5% by default.
- Policy Q&A: adjudicated accuracy (binary correct/incorrect by SME). 200-item golden set.
- Troubleshooting: end-state task success rate (binary) + average number of bot turns to resolution.

Acceptance thresholds (proposed, adjustable)
- Invoice extraction: F1 >= 0.92
- Policy Q&A: accuracy >= 0.84 on 200-item set
- Troubleshooting: success rate increase >= 20% vs current baseline or 0.30 absolute improvement; aim for reduction in average steps >= 25%

Ingestion checklist (Marissa to validate)
- Verify newline-delimited JSON format and UTF-8 encoding.
- Confirm mandatory fields: session_id, timestamp, user_text, bot_text (if present), metadata.json (optional).
- Confirm PII redaction: email addresses, phone numbers, full names -> replaced with placeholders. Keep hashed ids for join keys.
- Sample size validation: 2,000 rows, index.csv mapping to original ids.

Costs and quantized run note
- We will run baseline-2 (8-bit quant) to provide a conservative cost estimate. Preliminary estimate for 2k set: ~0.45 USD per 1k tokens processed on quantized baseline; final token estimate will be in token_cost_estimate.txt after we inspect the file.

Deliverables we will upload to the shared drive
- ingestion_report.md
- baseline_results.json
- token_cost_estimate.txt
- poc_final_report.pdf

Next steps / timeline summary
- EOD Apr 13: Datascape uploads 2k sample (Elena) — kickoff automated QA.
- Apr 16: internal kickoff (short sync) and confirm can run baseline-1/2.
- Apr 27: target delivery of final poc_final_report (10 business days from receipt).

Marissa — please share the ingestion checklist and the adjudication coordination sheet by EOD Apr 15. Karthik — I will hand off the baseline outputs and cost estimates to you for the customer report.

I'll attach a short template that Priyom will use for baseline_results + cost breakout.

—Priyom
Senior Applied ML Engineer — Redwood Inference
